lines.t: I see you playing the part until your heart is ‘bout to break. (Yeah!)
You’re out there living the dream? Or just living a lie?
Searching for "likes" while the light in your eyes starts to die?
You’re "thriving" in high school, yeah, you’re "loving" the sport,
But the court is a cage and your breath is getting short. (Keep running!)
You’re chasing a trophy, chasing a vibe, chasing a ghost—
But what’s the point of the win if you’re the one losing the most?
Is the locker room loud enough to drown out the silence?
Or is the war in your head reaching a level of violence?
Yeah, shut ‘em all out. Keep the mask on tight.
Tell ‘em you’re fine while you’re losing the fight. (I see you!)
And what about the "family"? What about the new "crew"?
Do they love the image or do they actually know you? (Do they?)
Do they hold you in the dark? Do they pray through the night?
Or do they only want the heat when you’re standing in light?
You’re trading the Sanctuary for a pagan parade—
Building a house out of cards just to sit in the shade.
I know the look in your eyes, I know the weight of the mask,
I know the questions you’re way too terrified to ask!
Is it everything you hoped? Is it really that sweet?
Or are you just walking on glass with blood on your feet?
Clock is ticking, pixels flickering, yeah, you’re losing the soul.
Trying to patch up the puncture while you’re losing control.
You’re building a kingdom on a handful of sand—
How’s it feel to have the world and nothing in your hand?
Are you happy? (Are you?) Or are you just hiding away?
Is the smile just a price that you’re willing to pay?
Is it empty? (So empty!) Does it leave you cold in the night?
Chasing a shadow and calling it light?
I know the Mender... I know the Peace...
I’m waiting for the moment you find your release.
Look, don’t get it twisted, I ain't throwing no stones,
I’m just hearing the rattle of the dry, brittle bones. (Rattle!)
You’re addicted to the ego, intoxicated by the "fame,"
But the Enemy is laughing while he’s carving your name.
You think you’re the pilot? You’re just a passenger now,
Selling the crown for a seat in the back of the crowd.
Trading the Living Water for a cup full of salt,
And when it all falls down, tell me, whose is the fault? (Who?!)
You’re running from the Altar to a stage made of tin—
I’m screaming "REPENT!" while you’re settling in!
The Father is calling, the debt has been paid,
So why are you still sleeping in the grave you made?!
Is it enough? Is it enough?
The world is a liar, the road is too rough!
You can fake the holiday, you can fake the win,
But you can't fake the Spirit that’s calling from within!
I see the crack in the stone! I see the heart on the shelf!
You’re a stranger to the Father, you’re a ghost to yourself!
I’m standing in the gap! I’m praying for the break!
For every single move and every breath that you take!
Are you happy? (Are you?) Or are you just hiding away?
Is the smile just a price that you’re willing to pay?
Is it empty? (So empty!) Does it leave you cold in the night?
Chasing a shadow and calling it light?
I know the Mender... I know the Peace...
I’m waiting for the moment you find your release.
Are you happy? Or are you just hiding away?
Is the smile just a price that you’re willing to pay?
Is it empty? Does it leave you cold in the night?
Chasing a shadow and calling it light?
I know the answer.
I see the mask.
(Beat of silence)
But I’m staying.
I’m waiting.
